Question: What are the expense payment amount of all claims by claim number?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    ca.Claim_Amount AS expense_payment_amount
FROM Expense_Payment ep
INNER JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
INNER JOIN Claim c
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

Question: What are the expense payment amount of all claims by claim number?
What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
JOIN Policy p
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Holder ph
    ON p.Policy_Holder_Identifier = ph.Policy_Holder_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp2
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp2.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr2
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cr2.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    ph.Policy_Holder,
    p.Premium_Amount_Paid;

Question: What are the loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by claim number and corresponding policy number, policy holder and premium amount paid?
What is the average loss of each policy by policy number and number of claims where loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Number_Of_Claims,
    AVG(
        COALESCE(lp.Amount, 0) +
        COALESCE(lr.Amount, 0) +
        COALESCE(ep.Amount, 0) +
        COALESCE(er.Amount, 0)
    ) AS Average_Loss
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp_lp
    ON cp_lp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lpt
    ON lpt.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp_lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lpt.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr_lr
    ON cr_lr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lrt
    ON lrt.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr_lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lrt.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp_ep
    ON cp_ep.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ept
    ON ept.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp_ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ept.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr_er
    ON cr_er.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve ert
    ON ert.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr_er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ert.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Policy_Number;

What are the loss reserve amount of all claims by claim number?

    ca.Claim_Amount AS Loss_Reserve_Amount

Question: What are the loss reserve amount of all claims by claim number?
What is the total loss of each policy that an agent has sold by agent id where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amounts?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Agent_Identifier,
    c.Policy_Identifier,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp.Amount END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr.Amount END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cp2.Amount END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN cr2.Amount END), 0) AS Total_Loss
FROM Policy p
JOIN Claim c
    ON c.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr
    ON cr.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = cr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Payment cp2
    ON cp2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Claim_Reserve cr2
    ON cr2.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Agent_Identifier,
    c.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY
    p.Agent_Identifier,
    c.Policy_Identifier;
